The trick with walnut is to add some car polish to it.

We have tried few different car polish brands and couple of the official case brass polishes, some work pretty good, but corn cob media just doesn't clean as well as stainless steel media tumbler does. Stainless steel media cleans also the insides of cases pretty well, which is better if you store your reloads for a longer time.

Corn cob polishing is faster since you don't have to dry the brass after polishing, so it has that going on for it.
